facts.text: The brown goshawk wears grey upperparts, a chestnut collar, and rufous underparts finely barred with white.
facts.quote: Its upperparts are grey with a chestnut collar; its underparts are mainly rufous, finely barred with white.

facts.text: Brown goshawks mostly eat other medium-sized birds, but also take rats and rabbits.
facts.quote: Brown goshawks feed mainly on other medium-sized birds, while small mammals such as rats and rabbits are also taken.

facts.text: It can catch prey as large as domestic fowls, currawongs and even kookaburras.
facts.quote: right up to birds the size of domestic fowls and even large, aggressive birds such as currawongs and kookaburras.

facts.text: One of its hunting tricks is flying through undergrowth to flush small prey out of cover.
facts.quote: The main methods of catching prey are still-hunting, by which the goshawk waits on a hidden perch until prey comes within striking distance, and flying through undergrowth attempting to flush out small prey.

facts.text: When spotted, the goshawk faces angry mobs of ravens, crows and magpies that harass it until it leaves.
facts.quote: larger birds such as ravens, crows and magpies will aggressively mob it until it leaves the area.

facts.text: It nests in tall trees on a stick platform lined with green leaves, usually laying three eggs.
facts.quote: It nests in tall trees on a platform of sticks and twigs lined with green leaves.  The clutch size is usually three, sometimes two or four.

facts.text: Chicks hatch after about 30 days of incubation and leave the nest roughly 31 days later.
facts.quote: The incubation period is about 30 days, with chicks fledging about 31 days after hatching.

facts.text: Around Canberra, look for it in eucalypt forests and woodlands, as well as farmland and urban areas.
facts.quote: In Australia, it is found mainly in eucalypt forests and woodlands, as well as farmland and urban areas.

facts.text: The brown goshawk ranges widely across Australia, New Guinea, New Caledonia, Vanuatu and Fiji.
facts.quote: The brown goshawk is widespread through Australia, Wallacea, New Guinea, New Caledonia, Vanuatu and Fiji.
